[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-9m[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Saved common placeholder tags in prompt completion[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Every `<foobar>` tag the user writes in a prompt is saved to a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]durable, capped, frecency-ranked store, and those saved tags appear[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]beneath the current prompt's own tags in the `<` completion menu, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]rendered in a visually distinct style that makes the two groups [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]tellable apart at a glance.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase/repos/plans/202607/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]common_placeholder_tags.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Placeholder candidate sources and common-tag input in [/bold #D7AFFF]        [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]sase-core[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]core[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]'Phase core — sase-core: candidate sources and common-tag input' [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]section: extend the Rust placeholder completion engine so candidates [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]carry a prompt/common source, accept a caller-supplied common-tag list, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and emit prompt-local candidates before common ones; update the PyO3 [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]binding, the xprompt LSP call sites, and the version contract.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Durable common-placeholder store and prompt recording hook[/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]store[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]'Phase store — durable common-placeholder store' section: add a capped, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]atomically-written JSON store of placeholder tags ranked by use count, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]record tags from every submitted or abandoned prompt through the shared [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]prompt-history choke points, and seed the store once from existing [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]prompt history.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Config field, warm cache, and completion menu wiring[/bold #D7AFFF]          [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]wiring[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core, store[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]'Phase wiring — config, warm cache, and menu behavior' section: add the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]ace.prompt_completion.common_placeholder_count config field, warm the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]store off-thread into an app-level cache, and thread common candidates [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]through the placeholder menu's open, refresh, and accept paths with the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]auto-versus-manual empty-prefix rule.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
